question: Is our webhook still disabled? If so, please turn it back on.

model.source: recorded from claude-opus-5-5 through the anthropic provider

replies.text:
**It's back on.** Webhook wh_31c9 (https://hooks.kitewood.example/fernway) was disabled, so I turned it on again. A fresh check shows it's now active with 0 consecutive failures, and deliveries will start again with the next event.

Its last failure was a timeout after 10.0s. Your endpoint has to reply with a 2xx status within 10 seconds, and after 50 failures in a row Fernway turns the webhook off again [help:webhooks@2#2]. If that endpoint is still slow, it's worth fixing so the webhook doesn't get disabled again. Your other webhook, wh_52aa, was already active.
